log.utf16_converted: Shader file in UTF-16: converted to UTF-8.
error.no_main_image: No mainImage function found: this is not a Shadertoy shader (Image tab).
log.warn_ichannel: iChannel%d is read by the shader but has no texture: it stays black (// iChannel%d=image.png, noise or grid).
log.shader_overrides: Shader settings (// key=value) take priority over the window.
error.codec_container: %ls cannot be stored in a %ls file (WebM needs VP9 or AV1; MOV does not take VP9 or AV1).
log.codec_cpu_only: %ls has no hardware encoder here: using the CPU.
error.encoder_missing: This ffmpeg has no "%ls" encoder. Install a full ffmpeg build (see the README) or pick another format.
error.gif_too_big: A GIF of %dx%d with %lld frames would need too much memory (palette computed on the whole animation). Reduce the size, frame rate or duration.
log.gif_fps: GIF: %g frames/s is more than most viewers play; 15 to 25 frames/s is suggested.
log.depth10: 10-bit output: rendering in 16 bits per channel.
log.depth_cpu_only: 10-bit output: hardware encoders are 8-bit only, using the CPU.
log.audio_ignored: This output format has no sound: the audio file is ignored.
ini.depth: 8 or 10 (bits per channel; 10 for H.265, AV1, VP9, ProRes, 16-bit PNG/TIFF)
ini.name: output file name template: {shader} {w} {h} {fps} {date} {codec}
ini.exists: when the output already exists: overwrite, number or skip
error.dnxhr_size: DNxHR needs a size of at least 256x120.
error.channel_read: Cannot read the texture %ls (ffmpeg could not decode it).
ini.ichannel: texture of iChannel0-3: image path, noise or grid (+ .filter nearest|linear|mipmap, .wrap clamp|repeat, .vflip 0|1)
ini.mouse: fixed iMouse: x,y as fractions of the size (0,0 = bottom left), add ,down for a pressed button
ini.date: fixed iDate: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (reproducible render)
log.pass_common: Common code found (placed before every pass).
log.buffers_replay: The buffers keep a history: replaying %lld frames before the first frame to encode (nothing is encoded for them).
error.buffers_unavailable: This graphics card cannot render to 32-bit float buffers (needed by Buffer A-D).
log.compat_version: A #version line was ignored: the program compiles in GLSL 3.30 core.
log.compat_extension: A #extension line was ignored (not needed here).
log.compat_vr: mainVR (VR shader) is not supported: only the Image tab is rendered.
log.compat_sound: mainSound (Sound tab) is not supported: it is ignored.
log.compat_cubemap: samplerCube (cubemap) is not supported yet: the channel stays black.
log.compat_volume: sampler3D (volume texture) is not supported yet: the channel stays black.
log.compat_mouse: iMouse is read: it stays 0 unless you set // mouse=x,y (fractions of the size).
log.compat_date: iDate is read: the real date is used, so two renders differ (// date=2026-03-14T15:09:26 fixes it).
log.compat_channel_time: iChannelTime is read: it is always 0 (no animated channel).
log.queue_restored: Queue restored from the last session: %d shader(s) still to render (press Start).
log.endaction_sleep: End of the batch: the computer goes to sleep in 15 seconds (close the program to cancel).
ini.endaction: after a successful batch: none, folder (show the last file) or sleep
ini.variant: extra rendering of the same shader: name:key=value|key=value (e.g. 720p:width=1280|height=720|crf=23); repeat the line for each variant
ini.gpu: graphics card on a two-GPU PC (Linux): default, high (the powerful one) or low (the integrated one); needs a restart
error.disk_full: Not enough disk space on %ls: about %.0f MB needed, %.0f MB free.
log.perfect_loop: Perfect loop: period %g s -> duration %g s
error.render_size: Render size %dx%d (resolution x smoothing) exceeds the GPU limit (%d).
error.framebuffer: Incomplete framebuffer (resolution too large for this GPU?).
error.blur_unavailable: Motion blur unavailable (the GPU rejected the floating-point framebuffer).
error.ffmpeg_launch: Cannot launch ffmpeg. Place ffmpeg in the same folder as ShaderToMP4.
error.ffmpeg_failed: ffmpeg stopped with an error (see the log above).
log.resume: Resume: %d part(s) already finished out of %lld.
error.assemble_failed: Assembling the parts failed (see the log). The parts are kept: run again to retry.
log.interrupted: Interrupted: %lld/%lld parts finished, kept in %ls (run again to resume).
log.measure_encoder_bound: Measure: the renderer waited for the encoder %.0f%% of the time (encoding is the bottleneck: try a faster preset or encoder=auto).
log.measure_gpu_bound: Measure: waiting for the encoder %.0f%% of the time (the GPU is the bottleneck).
log.encoder_unavailable: Encoder %ls unavailable on this PC: falling back to the CPU.
error.gl_core: OpenGL 3.3 core unavailable. Update the graphics driver.
error.sha_mismatch: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the downloaded file does not match: file rejected.
error.ffmpeg_not_in_archive: ffmpeg not found in the archive.
error.download_unsupported: Automatic download of ffmpeg is not available on this system. Install ffmpeg (for example with Homebrew: brew install ffmpeg) or place it next to the application.
selftest.fmt_no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg not found: output formats not tested

ini.header1: ShaderToMP4 - settings (saved by the window at each render)
ini.header2: Each value can be overridden in a shader, in a comment, e.g.:  // duration=30
ini.duration: seconds (90 = one full loop of this shader)
ini.crf: quality: 0 = lossless, 12 = nearly perfect, 18 = very good
ini.preset: ultrafast ... medium ... slow ... veryslow (slower = smaller file)
ini.color: bt709, bt709full (full range), srgb or bt601
ini.blur: motion blur: sub-frames per frame (1 = none, 4, 8, 16)
ini.shutter: blur shutter, as a fraction of a frame (0.5 = 180 degrees)
ini.loop: shader period in seconds: the duration becomes a whole multiple (0 = free)
ini.encoder: cpu, auto, nvenc, amf or qsv (hardware encoding when available)
ini.metadata: 1 = write title and comment in the video file, 0 = none
ini.pbo: depth of the GPU read-back queue (2 to 8)
ini.chunk: render in parts of N seconds, resumable after an interruption (0 = never)

ui.tip.folder: Open the folder of the selected shader's video

ui.tip.resolution: Video size in pixels. Pick a preset or type a custom size
ui.tip.fps: Frames per second (1 to 240): you can type any value
ui.tip.smoothing: Smoothing: render at N times the size, then downscale. Cleaner edges, slower render
ui.tip.duration: Duration in seconds or mm:ss (e.g. 90 or 1:30)
ui.tip.start_time: Start time in the shader (iTime), in seconds or mm:ss
ui.preset.none: No preset file in the presets folder
ui.tip.chip_more: More presets, and your own .ini files from the presets folder
ui.tip.depth: Bits per channel: 10 removes banding in gradients (H.265, AV1, VP9, ProRes, PNG/TIFF)
ui.tip.estimate: Estimated size of one output file (rough: depends on the shader)
ui.tip.forced: Settings written as // key=value in the selected shader take priority over the window
ui.tip.codec: H.264: plays everywhere. H.265: smaller files. VP9, AV1: open formats (CPU only, slower). ProRes, DNxHR: editing formats (MOV, large files). Ignored for GIF, WebP and image sequences
ui.tip.preset: Encoding speed: slower = smaller file at equal quality
ui.tip.quality: Constant quality: 0 = lossless, 12 = nearly perfect, 18 = very good, 23 = good
ui.tip.container: File format: MP4 (universal), MOV, MKV or WebM (VP9/AV1 only); GIF and WebP (animated image); PNG, TIFF, EXR (numbered image sequence in a folder). Entries marked "not in this ffmpeg" need a fuller ffmpeg build
ui.tip.encoder: CPU: best quality. NVENC / AMF / QuickSync: much faster (falls back to CPU if unavailable)
ui.tip.bitrate: Fixed bitrate in kb/s instead of constant quality (0 = use the CRF)
ui.tip.color: Color space and range of the video
ui.tip.blur: Motion blur: average of several sub-frames per frame
ui.tip.loop: Shader period in seconds: the duration becomes a whole multiple for a perfect loop (0 = free)
ui.tip.audio: Sound file to mix in, aligned with the “Start” time
ui.tip.output: Output folder (empty = next to the shader file)
ui.tip.profile_save: Save the settings to a profile (.ini)
ui.tip.chip_draft: 720p, 30 fps, medium quality, fast encoding: for testing
ui.tip.chip_youtube: 1080p, 60 fps, H.264, very good quality: ready for YouTube
ui.tip.preview: Show a frame of the shader at this time  -  Ctrl+P
